title: Pentaryn Pins
description: Pin a character to a player: with the world switch on, that player sees the scene their character's token is on (moving the token moves them, with core's own pull) and ignores GM scene activation; the sheet says 'Pinned to {player}'. GM right-click on empty canvas: Prompt note, Gather logged-in players here, Teleport pinned character (with its summons and pets). Exposes game.pentaryn.pins.

recommends.reason: Wraps Scene#_onActivate for pinned players (MIXED); without it it is wrapped by hand.
Puts a pinned player on their character's scene and level at login (it reads pinnedToken); without it a pinned player logs in on the active scene until the next pull.
Teleport pinned character calls its teleportToken, which brings the character's summons and pets; without it teleport answers UNSUPPORTED.
The GM canvas menu's Prompt note calls its place; without it the item is hidden.

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), enable 'Pentaryn Pins', then reload.
